LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Purchase FBC: Firebreak and invite your friends to play the full game for free on any platform. FBC: Firebreak is a three-player cooperative first-person shooter set within a mysterious federal agency under assault by otherworldly forces. 

Download Free Trial –version of the game to play FBC: Firebreak with friends for free on any platform*! 

Free Trial -version allows you to join FBC: Firebreak game sessions through invite if your friend owns the full game. There’s no time limit on how long it works. 

Here is how it works: 
- Own a copy of FBC: Firebreak 
- Have up to 2 friends install Free Trial –version of the game 
- Send them a party-code or an invite on any platform* 
- Play the full game together and have some fun! 

Survival in this three-player cooperative FPS hinges on quick thinking and seamless teamwork as you scramble to tame raging paranatural crises across a variety of unexpected locations.  

*Using Free Trial requires at least an Essential Game Pass subscription on Xbox.
LocalizedProperties.ShortDescription: Purchase FBC: Firebreak and invite your friends to play the full game for free on any platform. FBC: Firebreak is a three-player cooperative first-person shooter set within a mysterious federal agency under assault by otherworldly forces.

Features: Dive into the Federal Bureau of Control’s (FBC) unpredictable and extradimensional headquarters during its darkest—and strangest—hours.
As one of the FBC’s fearless first responders, you and your team are on call to confront everything from reality-warping anomalies to otherworldly monsters.
Join forces with friends or strangers to tackle crisis as a well-oiled crew. Survival in this three-player cooperative FPS hinges on quick thinking and seamless teamwork.
Before deploying, select your weapon and customize your Firebreaker’s Crisis Kit with specialized tools, grenades, support items, and paranatural augments.
Experiment with different loadouts to perfect your playstyle and synergize with your team, giving you the edge to succeed in every crisis, no matter the difficulty.
Return to the strange and unexpected world of Control or venture in for the first time in this standalone, multiplayer experience.
